description.value:
When your bonded familiar hits a creature you can see within 60 feet of you with a weapon attack on its turn, you can use your Reaction to expend a Spell Slot of 1st level or higher. The target creature takes damage of the type gained through your Familiar Bonus Damage equal to 1d8 per level of the spell slot.

Additionally, it has to make a Constitution Saving Throw or suffer one of the following effects until the end of your bonded familiar's next turn, based on your chosen Wild Domain:

Familiar Bonus Damage
Wild DomainEffect
DunesTarget is Blinded.
MarshesAttack Rolls against the target have Advantage and any healing it receives is halved.
PeaksTarget is Dazed.
TundrasTarget is Restrained.
WavesTarget is knocked Prone and moved to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of its original position.
WealdsAttack Rolls against the target have Advantage. You or any of your allies regain hit points equal to your Witch level + your spellcasting ability modifier if they reduce the target to 0 hit points.
